inspiration: Splash puffs at contact sized from the body's collider, faced to the wake only while moving, spawned at a speed-driven rate from the effect script (src/rendering/water-hit-effect.ts lines 9-38).
Additive two-sided celestial sprite with depth write off, for a moon or sun glow (src/rendering/sky-renderer.ts lines 25-33).
Per-vertex baked glow mixed into the lighting term through a half-domain step (src/objects/lit-actor.ts lines 193-194). Recreate with an explicit tint ramp.
Damped bone chain with a stiffness term and a collision resolve limit for hair and cape (src/objects/dynamic-hair-simulation.ts lines 17, 23; names only).
Camera handedness fix in the projection matrix, with the up axis set once (src/rendering/ue2-conventions.ts lines 10, 17, 19). Useful when importing mirrored data.
Sky and environment colour pipeline (sky-renderer.ts, env-info.ts, l2-env.ts): only the sky-renderer head was read.

briefs.label: shoreline splash puffs
briefs.why: a splash that grows with the body and faces the wake only while moving
briefs.keep: size tied to the body's collider; spawn rate driven by speed
briefs.change: a flat sprite burst in our own shapes and palette, faced away from the wake

briefs.label: night-sky moon glow
briefs.why: an additive, two-sided body that reads as a glow at dusk
briefs.keep: additive blending, depth write off, two-sided sprite
briefs.change: our own disc and a dusk-tinted halo, with a different count of bodies

briefs.label: vertex-baked glow mixing
briefs.why: baked per-vertex glow softens the lighting
briefs.keep: baked per-vertex glow mixed with the lighting term
briefs.change: an explicit tint ramp in our own shader, not a modulate domain

briefs.label: springy cape bones
briefs.why: a short damped chain sways and stops on contact
briefs.keep: a damped bone chain with a collision limit
briefs.change: fewer segments and our own wind-driven sway law, not input-driven

cross_link: Camera: ue2-conventions.ts (projection handedness fix). VFX: water-hit-effect.ts, sky-renderer.ts. Animation: dynamic-hair-simulation.ts. Sound, zones, spawns, loot, HUD: no assets; src game and UI files not read.
